entities.name: Shadowspear
entities.description: A legendary equipment spear pulled by Elspeth from a nightmare, which she claimed to be the true Khrusor.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who dreamed Shadowspear into being, escaped the Underworld and defeated Heliod.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who spread nightmares throughout Theros and fed on Elspeth's memories.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The God of the Sun, whose spear Khrusor was shattered by Elspeth's weapon.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the Dead who imprisoned Heliod in the Underworld.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Realm of Erebos where Elspeth rested.

entities.name: Ilysia
entities.description: Place on Theros where Elspeth was disturbed.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where the events occurred.

events.summary: Elspeth pulls Heliod's spear Khrusor from her nightmare, becoming Shadowspear.
events.quote: Elspeth pulled Heliod's spear, Khrusor , from her dream which in real life became Shadowspear.

events.summary: Elspeth escapes the Underworld, gathering followers against Heliod.
events.quote: Elspeth eventually staged an escape from the Underworld

events.summary: Heliod's spear shatters against Shadowspear and Erebos imprisons Heliod forever.
events.quote: Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever

relations.quote: By defeating his most hated enemy, Elspeth won the God of the Dead's eternal gratitude
Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever
